product.name: Monoprice 1000ft CL2-rated Quad-Shielded 18AWG RG-6/U Bulk Coaxial Cable Black
product.description: RG‑6/U Quad Shielded Coaxial Cable is great for high bandwidth applications, including antenna connections, cable television and satellite installations, and interference free speaker wire runs. The durable 18 AWG copper‑clad steel center conductor is surrounded by a foam polyethylene dielectric, with two active shield layers of Mylar® polyester film foil, which provides 99~100% coverage, and two layers of aluminum braid shielding, with 95% coverage.
